account_clear_confirm_description: This wipes the library, watch progress and history for this profile from every device. Installed addons and appearance settings stay.
account_danger_after: profile. Other profiles and your account are untouched. This cannot be undone.
account_danger_before: Clear every synced library item, watch-progress entry and history row for the
account_history_empty_description: Titles you finish will be listed here, newest first.
account_section_storage_description: What this server keeps for the profile
account_signin_description: The email and password for your Nuvio account.
account_storage_description: What's synced to your account, per profile.
addons_browse_description: Stremio's community directory and the addon catalogs your addons publish.
addons_configuration_required_note: This addon has to be configured before it can be installed. Its configuration page gives you the URL to add.
addons_empty_description: The directories returned no addons. Try again later.
addons_legal_sources: Listed by {sources}. Nuvio Web doesn't host, review or endorse any of them.
addons_legal_rule: Installing an addon that infringes copyright or breaks the law where you live is forbidden.
addons_warning_adult: This addon says it serves adult content.
addons_warning_p2p: This addon says its streams are peer-to-peer (torrents). Whether you may use them depends on where you live.
admin_access_description: While locked, only the addresses below can sign in or register, and anyone else already signed in is signed out on their next request. Server admins are always allowed, listed or not.
admin_activity_description: Sign-ins and sign-ups on this server, by day (UTC). The event log keeps 90 days.
admin_allowlist_empty: The allowlist is empty, so only server admins can sign in.
admin_backends_allow_description: Lets anyone signing in type in a backend of their own. Those accounts are kept apart from everyone else's, can never be admins, and are refused while the server is locked.
admin_backends_ban_confirm_description: Nobody can sign in through it any more, and everyone signed in through it is signed out on their next request.
admin_backends_default_description: Replaces the official Nuvio API for everyone who doesn't pick a backend. Leave the URL empty to use the official one. It may be on your local network. Changing it signs out everyone on the previous default.
admin_backends_empty: Nobody has signed in through a custom backend yet.
admin_backends_seen_description: Every backend someone signed in through, most recent first.
admin_backends_test_failed: The backend didn't answer with that URL and key.
admin_backends_unban_confirm_description: People can sign in through it again. Nobody is signed back in.
admin_builtin_account_first: Create your account on the built-in backend first: switching signs you out of this one.
admin_builtin_create_description: Admin emails can't sign up through the backend's API, since nothing confirms an email there. Create yours here, then sign in with it once you switch.
admin_builtin_description: This server can be its own Nuvio backend: accounts and their data live in its database, and any app that speaks the Nuvio API can use it with this URL and key.
admin_builtin_has_account: You have an account on it.
admin_builtin_in_use: In use as the default backend
admin_builtin_use_note: Switching signs out everyone on the current default. They sign up again here: their data on the old backend stays there.
admin_error_remove_self: You cannot remove your own address while you are signed in.
admin_intro: Who has signed in to this server, and who is allowed to. Visible only to the addresses in {variable}.
admin_open_summary: Anyone with a Nuvio account can use this server.
admin_notifications_description: Things on this server that may need a look. Kept for 90 days.
admin_notifications_email_description: Each new notification is also sent to your address.
admin_notifications_email_no_smtp: Set up SMTP in Settings first, or no email can be sent.
admin_notification_custom_backend_seen: A new custom backend is in use
admin_smtp_description: The server this instance sends mail through, for notifications and test emails. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin_smtp_error_host: Enter a host name or IP address, without a scheme or port.
admin_smtp_error_from: Enter the address mail is sent from.
admin_smtp_password_set: Saved, leave empty to keep it
admin_smtp_password_keep: A password is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
admin_smtp_password_none: Leave empty if the server needs no password.
admin_smtp_test_description: Sends a test email to your own address with the saved settings.
admin_smtp_test_not_configured: SMTP isn't set up, or the saved password can no longer be read (the session secret changed). Save the settings again.
admin_smtp_test_auth: The SMTP server refused the username or password.
admin_smtp_test_connection: Couldn't connect to the SMTP server. Check the host, port and encryption.
admin_smtp_test_timeout: The SMTP server took too long to answer.
admin_smtp_test_rejected: The SMTP server refused the message. Check the from address.
admin_smtp_test_unknown: Sending failed. The server log has the details.
admin_stats_top_titles_description: Titles played in the last 7 days, ranked by how many accounts played them.
admin_stats_top_titles_empty: Nothing played in the last 7 days.
admin_stats_weeks_description: People active each week, split by whether it was their first week on this server.
admin_stats_weeks_aria: Returning and new people per week, last {count} weeks
admin_stats_active_description: People who signed in or used the app, per day (UTC).
admin_stats_new_accounts_description: Accounts signing in to this server for the first time, per day (UTC).
admin_stats_watch_description: Videos played per day (UTC), each counted on the day it was last played.
admin_stats_empty_accounts: No new accounts in this range.
auth_backend_description: Your account and data here are kept separately for each backend.
auth_backend_key_hint: The backend's anon or publishable key. Leave it empty for a Nuvio self-hosted server: it's read from the server.
auth_credentials_note: Your password goes to Nuvio once, to sign you in, and is never stored. This server keeps only the session Nuvio hands back.
auth_error_backend_banned: This server's admin has blocked that backend.
auth_error_backend_blocked: That backend points to this server itself or a reserved address, which it won't reach.
auth_error_backend_disallowed: This server doesn't allow custom backends.
auth_error_backend_invalid: That backend did not answer like a Nuvio backend.
auth_error_backend_key_invalid: Enter the backend's publishable key: letters, digits and . _ - + / = ~ only.
auth_error_backend_key_not_found: This backend doesn't publish its key. Paste its publishable key.
auth_error_backend_locked: This server is invite-only, so custom backends can't be used.
auth_error_backend_unreachable: Couldn't reach that backend. Try again later.
auth_error_backend_url_invalid: Enter an http(s) URL with no username, password, spaces, query or fragment.
auth_error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
auth_error_invite_only: This server is invite-only. Ask the server admin to add your email address.
auth_error_password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth_error_sign_in_failed: Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.
auth_error_sign_up_failed: Unable to create your account right now. Please try again.
auth_registered: Account created. Sign in to continue.
auth_sign_in_description: Enter your email and password to continue.
auth_sign_up_description: Sign up with your email and a password.
calendar_empty_description: Add series to your library and their new episodes show up here.
calendar_subtitle: Episodes of the series in your library, this past week and coming up.
collection_no_folders_description: Add a folder and attach one or more catalogs to fill it.
collection_not_found_description: This collection may have been renamed or removed.
collection_view_default_hint: Follow the app's own layout (tabs here)
collections_delete_description: The collection and its folders are removed. Titles in your library stay.
collections_empty_description: Bundle catalogs from your addons into folders and browse them your way.
collections_subtitle: Group catalogs into folders for a custom layout.
discover_no_catalogs_description: Add a catalog addon to start browsing movies and series.
discover_subtitle: Browse every catalog your addons provide.
downloads_empty_description: Open a title's sources and use the download button next to one to watch it offline.
downloads_error_drm: This stream is DRM-protected, so it can't be downloaded.
downloads_error_live: This is a live stream : it never ends, so it can't be downloaded.
downloads_error_storage: Not enough storage: this needs {needed}, {free} is free.
downloads_started_description: Follow it on the Downloads page.
downloads_subtitle: Saved on this device, playable without a connection.
downloads_unsupported_description: This browser can't store files for offline viewing.
error_cloudflare: The Nuvio Servers have restricted access to this client via Cloudflare. Please wait a few minutes before retrying.
error_download_navigation: Downloads are fetched by the app, not opened directly.
error_download_source_url: A download source must be an http(s) URL.
error_profile_changed: Another tab switched profile. Pick a profile to continue.
error_too_many_streams: Too many open tabs for this account
folder_dialog_description: Pick one or more catalogs to feed this folder, and how its tile looks.
folder_hide_title: Hide the title on the tile
folder_no_catalogs: No catalogs yet : install an addon that serves some.
folder_shape_hint: Used when the folder has a cover image or an emoji.
health_degraded: The Nuvio API is degraded. Syncing library, progress and history may be slow or delayed.
health_down: Can't reach the Nuvio API. Your library and history may be out of date; changes are queued and will sync when it's back.
health_offline: You're offline. Browsing shows the last synced data; changes are queued and sync when you reconnect.
health_stalled: Some of your changes haven't synced. They're saved locally and will retry : check your connection or sign in again.
home_empty_description: Add a catalog addon and rows of movies and series fill in here.
library_empty_description: Add movies and series from any detail page and they'll show up here.
notice_description: How Nuvio Web works, in short.
notice_hosts_nothing: Nuvio Web hosts no video, metadata or subtitles. Everything you browse and play comes from the third-party addons you choose to install.
notice_responsibility: You are responsible for the addons you add and for having the right to access what they return. Add only addons you trust.
notice_unofficial: This is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nuvio.
offline_body: Your downloads still play. Everything else comes back with the connection.
offline_empty_description: Download a title from its sources while you're online to watch it here.
player_audio_codec_unsupported: Its audio codec (Dolby Digital, DTS or Atmos) can't be decoded here.
player_mpv_body: This source plays in mpv, which decodes it with your computer's hardware. Your progress is saved as you watch.
player_decode_body: This browser might not decode this source's video codec. If the picture looks fine, dismiss this.
player_decode_title: The video may not be playing
player_end_over: It's over : but these titles could interest you.
player_end_upcoming_rest: : {episode}. Meanwhile, these titles could interest you.
player_error_stopped: This source stopped playing and couldn't be recovered.
player_error_stream: This stream could not be played.
player_error_unsupported: This source can't play in the browser. Its container or codec isn't supported.
player_boost_unavailable: This source's host doesn't allow volume boost.
player_subtitle_load_failed: That subtitle file couldn't be loaded. Try another track.
profiles_delete_confirm_description: Its library, history and watch progress are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
profiles_delete_hint: Its library, history and progress are removed.
profiles_edit_description: Changes apply to this profile only.
profiles_error_last: You need at least one profile.
profiles_error_limit: You already have the maximum of 6 profiles.
profiles_error_locked: That profile is PIN-protected. Manage it in the Nuvio app.
profiles_error_primary: The primary profile can't be deleted.
profiles_pin_locked: {name} is PIN-protected. Switch to it in the Nuvio app.
profiles_primary_addons_hint: Off means this profile keeps its own addon list.
profiles_remember: Remember this profile on this browser
profiles_remember_hint: Off: you'll be asked who's watching after the browser restarts.
search_no_results: No results for "{term}". You might like:
settings_addons_blurb_cinemeta: Catalogs, posters and metadata for films and TV (IMDb ids).
settings_addons_blurb_tmdb: The Movie Database catalogs and artwork, many languages.
settings_addons_description: Catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles for this profile.
settings_addons_dialog_description: Paste a Stremio addon manifest URL.
settings_addons_disclaimer: Nuvio Web hosts nothing. Everything you see comes from the addons you install : you choose them and are responsible for what they return. Only add addons you have the right to use.
settings_addons_empty_description: Start with a metadata provider : catalogs, posters and details. Add a stream provider yourself once you're set up.
settings_addons_invalid_manifest: That URL doesn't serve a valid addon manifest.
settings_addons_load_failed: Couldn't load your addons. Reload to try again.
settings_addons_remove_description: Its catalogs, metadata and streams stop appearing across the app. You can add it back any time.
settings_appearance_description: Stored on your Nuvio account, per profile.
settings_audio_language_hint: Picked automatically when a file carries more than one audio track. The Nuvio app setting is read from the mobile app and never changed from here.
settings_autoplay_hint: Start the next episode automatically after one finishes.
settings_auto_skip_hint: Skip the intro, and go from the credits to the next episode, when skip times are known.
settings_dark_style_hint: Applies when the effective mode is dark.
settings_external_player_hint: Picking a source opens it in this app instead of the built-in player, on devices the app runs on: IINA is Mac only, Outplayer iPhone and iPad only, and Android always opens your default video app. Watch progress isn't saved for external playback.
settings_home_default_hint: Showing the first {count} catalogs in addon order. Move or hide any of them to arrange your own.
settings_home_description: Which catalogs your home screen shows, and in what order. Stored on your Nuvio account for this web app; catalogs from addons you install later appear at the end until you move them.
settings_home_empty: None of your addons serve a catalog yet.
settings_home_save_failed: Couldn't save your home layout : reverted.
settings_introdb_hint: Skip-intro / outro timestamps already work without one : this only folds in your own pending submissions and raises your rate limit.
settings_introdb_placeholder: Not set : public data is used
settings_language_hint: Saved on this browser. Changing it reloads the page.
settings_link_cache_hint: Debrid links expire : after this, the title resolves fresh.
settings_playback_description: How the player behaves for this profile.
settings_quality_hint: The player auto-picks the closest match from a source list. You can still choose any source manually.
settings_region_hint: Which country's streaming services the "Available on" list and the official-source Watch button use.
settings_reuse_link_hint: Re-open a title straight to its previous link instead of resolving again : faster for debrid addons.
settings_touch_gestures_hint: On phones and tablets: double tap left or right to seek 10s, press and hold for 2× speed, swipe up or down on the right for volume and on the left for brightness.
settings_section_home_description: Rows and catalogs on your home screen
settings_section_integrations_descriptio: TMDB, MDBList and other metadata providers
settings_section_sync_description: Library and progress sync with Nuvio
settings_subtitle_background_hint: A dark plate behind the text for readability.
settings_subtitle_outline_hint: A dark edge around the letters, readable on any picture.
settings_subtitle_language_hint: Turned on automatically when a stream offers a matching track.
settings_sync_connect_first: Connect {name} in the Nuvio app first
settings_sync_description: Choose where your library and watch progress live. Trakt and SIMKL need to be connected first.
settings_sync_footnote: Nuvio Sync is always the cross-device mirror. Trakt / SIMKL integration is coming.
shell_footer_tagline: A web client for your Nuvio library, addons and streams.
shell_install_description: Pick how you want it on this computer.
shell_install_web_description: Installs from this browser and opens in its own window, on this server.
shell_install_web_manual: Use Install in your browser's address bar or menu. Firefox can't install web apps.
shell_install_web_safari: In Safari, choose File, then Add to Dock.
shell_install_desktop_description: Has its own server built in, and plays the sources a browser can't with mpv.
shell_install_pick_platform: Pick the build for your computer.
watch_codec_blocked_body: Its {codec} video isn't supported here. Open it in an external player, or pick a different source.
watch_codec_blocked_title: This browser can't decode this source's video
watch_detail_no_metadata_body: No installed addon provides {type} metadata for {id}.
watch_detail_no_synopsis: No synopsis available for this title.
watch_external_body: Your playback settings send streams to an external app. Change this in Settings to watch in the browser.
watch_filter_p2p_hint: P2P sources stream over BitTorrent and don't play directly in the browser.
watch_filter_silent_hint: Their audio codec (Dolby / DTS / Atmos) can't be decoded by the browser : video plays without sound.
watch_link_copied_paste: Link copied : paste it into your player
watch_no_addon_streams_body: No installed addon returned a playable stream.
watch_no_stream_plays_here: None of your addons returned a stream that plays here.
watch_not_web_ready_body: Pick a different source, or open it in an external player.
watch_not_web_ready_title: This source can't play in the browser
watch_row_audio_risky_title: This audio codec may not play in the browser (no sound)
watch_row_video_risky_title: This video codec (HEVC / AV1) may not decode in the browser
watch_sources_hidden_body: Every source for this title is P2P or likely-silent : the default filters hide those.
watch_stream_error_body: Something went wrong finding a stream for this title.
auth_credentials_note_backend: Your password goes to {host} once, to sign you in, and is never stored here.
auth_credentials_note_server: Your account lives on this server; its password is only stored as a hash.
